title: Live status overlay (optional asset kind 'live', sli/1.6+)
description: Status observations from the live-status lane since the last full feed, during match hours. Readers overlay each entry on the day assets by event id when its status_observed_at is newer than the event's, then apply the manifest's compatibility.live_state_rule. No scores and no programme data.

generated_at.description: The newest observation in this asset

id.description: Event id in the same feed revision's day assets

status_normalized.description: scheduled | live | finished | postponed | cancelled | unknown
